name: open-semantic-lab/mw-json
description: Storing and editing of structured data based on MultiContentRevisions, json, json-schema and json-ld.
_comment_require: zordius/lightncandy and ml/json-ld are already present in MediaWiki core's
vendor/ on a stock OSL stack (lightncandy via core, ml/json-ld via
SemanticMediaWiki), so they need no deployment step.
mustache/mustache is NOT, so the wiki's composer.local.json must add
extensions/MwJson/composer.json to its merge-plugin include list, the same
way extensions/WSSlots and ExternalData already do. See docs/library-choices.md
for why lightncandy could not be used despite being already vendored.
